title: Correct two latched patch connections while preserving a third
instruction: Correct the crossed blue and orange patch leads so each occupies its matching port. Release each catch before withdrawing the plug, and leave each catch engaged afterward. Keep the green link connected throughout.
context: A configuration-repair draft requiring extraction and re-insertion without disturbing a correct neighboring connection.
limitations: Each 5 mm cable is a continuous chain of 22 rigid segments with passive bend/twist joints; fine cable elasticity and conductor physics are approximated.
The catch has an enlarged release paddle for parallel jaws. It is not an exact RJ45 connector model.
Joint continuity and connector seating proxy link continuity; packet transmission is not simulated.
Flexible cable self-contact, bend response, and coordinated latch manipulation await native execution.
